stories.title: Election Integrity or Voter Suppression? Trump's mail ballot order clears Supreme Court hurdle
stories.conservative_headline: SCOTUS Greenlights Trump's Push to Secure Mail Ballots as Democrats Panic Over Election Safeguards
stories.liberal_headline: Supreme Court Clears Path for Trump to Seize Control of Mail Voting Weeks Before Midterms
stories.poll_question: Should the president be able to set national mail ballot rules?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Uniform federal standards stop fraud and restore trust in mail ballots.

stories.poll_option1_desc: Licensed broadcasters have always faced fairness and equal-time obligations.

stories.poll_option1_desc: Medical and deployability standards should drive policy, not identity politics.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Qualified volunteers are being fired for who they are, not performance.

stories.title: Corporate Accountability or Lawfare? Supreme Court weighs Boulder's climate suit against Exxon and Suncor

stories.poll_option2_desc: Companies that misled the public should cover the costs communities face.
